title: RSF Drone Strike on Kosti Fuel Station Kills 1, Injures 14-15
detail: An RSF drone struck a fuel station and adjacent market area in Kosti, White Nile State, on June 21, 2026, killing one civilian and injuring 14-15 others. The same day, a separate RSF drone hit a gas station in El Obeid's city center, North Kordofan, also causing civilian casualties — part of an intensifying drone campaign against SAF-held economic infrastructure in central Sudan.

title: RSF Drones Strike Sewage Tankers in El Obeid, Killing Driver
detail: Two separate RSF drone strikes hit water/sewage tankers in central El Obeid on June 21, 2026: an early-afternoon strike injured 4 civilians, and an evening strike killed the tanker driver and wounded 2 more. The attacks were part of a drone campaign hitting the SAF-held North Kordofan capital at a rate of roughly 2-6 strikes per day through late June, part of the broader RSF siege dynamic later described by the UN as an escalating human rights crisis.
